components.name: Button
components.description: The default control in every Wild Path window: a firm ink edge, a Vellum fill on hover, and a pressed state that tints and sinks a pixel.
components.css: .ds-page { background: #f3ead7; padding: 12px; font-family: Signika, sans-serif; } .ds-btn { min-height: 1.9rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; background: #faf5e9; color: #2a2219; border: 1px solid rgba(88, 70, 46, 0.65); border-radius: 6px; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, border-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn:not(:disabled):hover { border-color: #2f6f68; background: #fffdf6; } .ds-btn:not(:disabled):active { border-color: #2f6f68; background: rgba(47, 111, 104, 0.14); transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a0711f; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Vellum field with an ink rule; Focus Brass outline on focus, Oxblood outline when invalid.
components.css: .ds-page { background: #f3ead7; padding: 12px; font-family: Signika, sans-serif; } .ds-input { width: 5rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.4rem; background: #fffdf6; color: #2a2219; border: 1px solid rgba(88, 70, 46, 0.65); border-radius: 3px; font: inherit; text-align: center; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a0711f; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { outline: 2px solid #8a3434; }

components.css: .ds-page { display: grid; gap: 0.35rem; background: #f3ead7; padding: 12px; font-family: Signika, sans-serif; color: #2a2219; } .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 2.6rem; padding: 0.3rem 0.45rem; background: #faf5e9; border: 1px solid rgba(88, 70, 46, 0.35); border-radius: 6px; } .ds-icon { width: 2rem; height: 2rem; border: 1px solid rgba(88, 70, 46, 0.35); border-radius: 4px; background: #e6dcc4; } .ds-main { display: grid; gap: 0.1rem; min-width: 0; } .ds-name { font-weight: 700; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-detail { color: #6a5d4c; font-size: 0.75rem; } .ds-cmd { min-width: 4.25rem; min-height: 1.9rem; background: #faf5e9; color: #2a2219; border: 1px solid rgba(88, 70, 46, 0.65); border-radius: 6px; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-cmd:not(:disabled):hover { border-color: #2f6f68; background: #fffdf6; } .ds-cmd:not(:disabled):active { border-color: #2f6f68; background: rgba(47, 111, 104, 0.14); transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-cmd:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a0711f; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-cmd:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-unavailable { border-style: dashed; opacity: 0.72; } .ds-unavailable .ds-name { color: #6a5d4c; }

components.css: .ds-card { max-width: 18rem; padding: 4px 6px; background: #faf5e9; color: #2a2219; border: 1px solid rgba(88, 70, 46, 0.35); border-radius: 4px; font-family: Signika, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; } .ds-cicon { width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 4px; background: #c79d5d; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-card ul { list-style: none; margin: 0.25rem 0 0; padding: 0; } .ds-card li { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.25rem 0; } .ds-card li + li { border-top: 1px solid rgba(88, 70, 46, 0.35); } .ds-out { padding: 0 0.375rem; border: 1px solid; border-radius: 3px; font-weight: bold; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-ok { border-color: #2f6b3a; background: color-mix(in srgb, #2f6b3a 18%, transparent); } .ds-fail { border-color: #8a3434; background: color-mix(in srgb, #8a3434 18%, transparent); } .ds-inspect { display: block; margin: 4px 0 0 auto; padding: 0; border: none; background: none; color: #2f6f68; font: inherit; font-size: 0.8em; text-decoration: underline; cursor: pointer; } .ds-inspect:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a0711f; outline-offset: 1px; }

narrative.overview:
Wild Path's windows read like a ledger kept on parchment: ink text, thin ruled borders, and rows of facts about a character, each one written by the engine and open to inspection. The page is warm and quiet so the numbers carry the weight. Verdigris is the annotator's second ink, marking what can be followed (a link, a tab, a total the engine worked out). Over the battle itself sits a different material: an ink-dark HUD, lit by Lantern Gold, that floats on the scene without hiding it.

The look is fixed. Every colour a Wild Path surface shows is set in `styles/wildpath.css` on the `--wp-*` custom properties, so sheets, dialogs and chat cards look the same under Foundry's light and dark themes. Density is moderate: compact rows and small labels, enough room that a player reads a number in the middle of a turn without hunting for it.

Controls are **tactile and confident**: things you press, not text you might click. They have a firm ink edge, a lighter fill on hover, and a pressed state that tints and sinks by a pixel. They get that weight from fill and border, never from shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Parchment page, ink text, ruled borders: windows, dialogs and chat cards share one material.
An ink-dark, translucent HUD (action bar, combat carousel) floats over the canvas, with Lantern Gold for the active thing.
Flat surfaces separated by tone and borders, with no shadows.
One interface face (Signika), with weight and size, not new fonts, setting the hierarchy.
Every state shows in a form besides colour: dashed borders, strikethrough, opacity, or text.

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: The page has one accent. Verdigris marks what can be followed or what the engine derived; it never decorates. Lantern Gold belongs to the HUD and does not appear on parchment.

rules.name: The Own Palette Rule
rules.body: A Wild Path surface sets its own background and text colour, so it stays readable whatever Foundry theme surrounds it.

rules.name: The Weight Not Face Rule
rules.body: Add hierarchy with weight, size and case. A new font family is reserved for language script. Headings in Wild Path windows and chat cards set Signika explicitly, so Foundry's display face doesn't leak in.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Never use `box-shadow` for depth. Lift something with a lighter tone, a border, or (for pressed controls) a heavier border or fill.

dos: Do take every colour from the `--wp-*` properties in `styles/wildpath.css`, and add a new property there when a new role appears.
Do keep Verdigris for links, hover, focus-adjacent states and engine-derived values. Keep Lantern Gold on the HUD.
Do show every state in a second form besides colour: a dashed border (unavailable or empty), strikethrough (spent), opacity (disabled or defeated), italic (concealed), or text (a tooltip reason).
Do use the 2px Focus Brass outline for keyboard focus on every interactive element (Lantern Gold on the HUD).
Do read the interface font from `var(--font-body, sans-serif)`.
Do dim secondary text with Faded Ink, not with opacity, which drops it under 4.5:1.
Do truncate long names with an ellipsis in rows and carousel tiles rather than letting them wrap.
Do give every new control the button's hover and pressed states.
donts: Don't use `box-shadow` for depth or emphasis anywhere. Use tone, borders and fills.
Don't show a state with colour alone, whether it's a hue change on a badge, a row or an icon.
Don't put Lantern Gold on parchment, or Verdigris on the dark HUD as its main accent.
Don't mark a callout or row with a coloured side rule thicker than 1px. Use a full 1px border and a tint.
